title: Add CSRF/state validation to OAuthBridge
description:
P1 finding from 10-agent swarm codebase audit (P1-013). OAuthBridgeController.ExchangeCode proxies POST body to GitHub with no state validation, no CSRF protection, no content-type restriction. App acts as open OAuth proxy enabling CSRF-based account linking attacks.

File: MemorySmith.App/Controllers/OAuthBridgeController.cs (lines 39-60)
Confidence: 85%
Source: codebase-audit-20260710-agent10-swarm-v2.md
